allocation_basis: Explicit best-estimate marginal judgments guided by the breadth of audited work, not copied expense ratios or a donor instruction. Central quantifies35% of the ordinary gift and retains65% unquantified. Other scenarios change quantified shares; remainder remains whole-gift cost without invented health. All allocations sum to1.
recurrent_overdose: Each funded offer is a distinct at-risk person covered by witness naloxone access for a finite period, not one kit, training, reported rescue or new lifetime. Effective-rescue probability includes actual availability, witnesses, alternative medication/EMS and successful delivery conditional on an event. Repeated nonfatal events leave the person alive. Compare exp(-[otherMortality+eventRate*fatalWithoutRescue*(1-baselineRescue)]*t) with the supported survival trajectory; hazard improvement lasts only activeYears. Afterward both face baseline hazard. Integrate only their survival difference to horizon.
prep: Among people at sexual acquisition risk, baseline acquisition hazard already reflects actual available care. Added effective coverage fraction changes protection only during supported time. Later infection remains possible in both arms. Count only finite HIV-free-state utility difference versus treated HIV; no HIV mortality advantage, untreated AIDS lifetime or secondary transmission bonus. Utility gap is an analyst prior, not patient-measured SFAF QALY. Trial-effectiveness coefficient includes trial adherence; added coverage is relative time added over actual access, not a second adherence multiplier.
nonoverlap: PrEP disjoint fraction explicitly excludes recipients/person-time covered by overdose survival stream. Count all offered-care costs and implementation harms even for excluded overlap; credit no PrEP health there. No HCV/MOUD survival or psychosocial utility added to overdose survivors. Actual linked records needed; disjoint fraction is a prior.
funding: Current public contracts, assistance,340B operations and other donors are baseline. Funding additionality separately discounts replacement of paid branch activity, not portfolio allocation or clinical effect. May2026 proposed bundle$8.587476M includes contingency and is conditional on finalized appropriations. June partial restorations prevent calling the earlier Pick Up Crew cuts a current verified gap. Funding room stays null, not zero.
resources: Gross associated envelope=whole gift+nominal OD offers*outside OD inputs+nominal PrEP offers*outside PrEP inputs. These hypothetical medication/lab/other payer inputs are outside direct branch cash and corporate overhead; no340B revenue or insurance transfer counted as extra real resources. It is not net induced societal cost, and saved HIV/EMS costs are not subtracted. Donor-pays stress moves outside input cost into branch cash once, reducing offers.
harm: Shared harms are gift-date PV losses per incremental offer, excluding losses already in survival/HIV-state comparisons; independent gift harm also gift-date PV and survives no added activity.
geography: All modeled health US. Independent branch residence shares describe where credited future health accrues, including mobility; clinic location alone is not residence evidence. SF nests in Bay per branch and harms. Shares unmeasured.
